story.fullStory:
Big & Rich's "Save A Horse" — original release 2004. "Save a Horse (Ride a Cowboy)" is a song written and recorded by American country music duo Big & Rich.

It was released in April 2004 as the second single from their debut album Horse of a Different Color.

The song received wide exposure when ESPN featured the song in commercials for its coverage of the 2004 World Series of Poker.
